I was unable to complete the task of finding the customer with the most cancellations in the history because I could not access the Magento admin panel. The admin login page at http://dockerized-magento.local/admin/index has username and password fields that are visible but not marked as interactive elements in the system, preventing any login attempts. I tried multiple approaches:

1. Multiple credential combinations: admin/admin1234, admin/admin, admin/password
2. Frontend store access and customer login
3. Search for 'cancellation' and 'orders' on the frontend
4. REST API access (404 error)
5. Developer tools and keyboard input attempts

All attempts failed due to the technical limitation where the login form input fields are not exposed as interactive elements. Without admin access, I cannot view customer cancellation data to determine which customer has the most cancellations.
